name: rust-frontend-staging-pin
body: Limit — The Rust frontend is pinned to the rust-analyzer release in `src/rustlib/Cargo.toml` and is always compiled `--release` into the outer profile's frontends dir; a staging failure skips rust rather than aborting the whole build. Upgrade — Move the pin only by editing `src/rustlib/Cargo.toml` and `src/rustlib/Cargo.lock` in one commit, then re-run `APG_REBUILD_FRONTENDS=1 cargo build` so a cached `deps/` artifact is not re-uplifted.
